parsed.rationale: I disagree with the team's STEMI call: this is sinus rhythm at about 70 bpm with normal QRS width and axis, and the precordial leads show only a mild concave upsloping ST segment into normal upright T waves (a normal variant) without the territorial ST elevation, reciprocal ST depression or Q waves that STEMI criteria require, though the limb leads are noisy and this tracing should be read alongside the patient's symptoms, troponin and serial ECGs.
